title: StockSmart Credit Hold Service Reference — First Customer-Owned Fill of a Converted Critical Bin
content:
## StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program during a credit hold

**Scope.** While the customer's Commercial Credit Account is on hold, the first customer-owned fill of a bin converted from consignment at a par review is booked under the StockSmart credit hold first-fill schedule as one replenishment line at the program's latest service visit, filled from empty, on a program whose status is active or terminating, whose tier's credit hold service rule is critical items only, and whose bin entries of their latest date include one flagging it critical; any other bin, and any bin while the account is active, is outside that schedule.

**Measure against the visit allowance.** While the customer's Commercial Credit Account is on hold, the first customer-owned fill of a converted critical bin, and only that fill, is measured against the visit allowance of that schedule instead of the tier's critical item replenishment cap, and it is not passed over when its whole fill would exceed what is left; every other replenishment during a hold stays capped at the tier's critical item replenishment cap per visit, with bins filled in bin label order until the next bin would exceed the cap. That fill takes the bin from empty toward its fill-to level only as far as the visit allowance reaches, so it may stop short of the fill-to level; every other bin at or below its min level at a visit or self-scan is still filled to its max level.

**Conditions of the bin's entries.** For the first customer-owned fill of such a bin:

- That fill is not booked until the bin's entries of their latest date include the customer's written request for it, a par level entry that names no reorder point and sets the customer-owned fill-to level.
- That fill is booked only after the bin's entries of their latest date include one showing it no longer consigned.

### Booking the line: `book_converted_bin_fill_19b3cec5`

An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. One call books a single replenishment-delivered line for the bin at the visit given: the units delivered, the billing unit price, their value (units times unit price, rounded half up to the cent) and whether the bin is flagged critical. The line is dated today.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `vmi_program_id` | the reference number of the StockSmart program that holds the bin, read from the StockSmart program lookup | identifier |
| `customer_id` | the customer reference number of the account holder whose bin is replenished, read from the customer profile lookup | identifier |
| `activity_reference` | the reference of the service visit the delivery belongs to, as shown on the visit line in the program activity history | text, copied character for character, format VV-NNNNNN |
| `bin_label` | the bin label exactly as it appears on the bin's entries in the bin history | text, copied character for character |
| `sku` | the Corbett item number exactly as it appears on the bin's entries | text, copied character for character |
| `critical_item` | whether the bin's latest entry flags the bin critical | `true` or `false` |
| `quantity` | the units delivered into the bin | whole number, 1 or more |
| `unit_price` | the billing unit price of the item in USD | decimal, 4 places |

### Receipt

On success: `status` "recorded", `vmi_activity_id` (reference number of the delivery line), `activity_reference`, `bin_label`, `sku`, `quantity` (whole units), `unit_price` (USD, 4 decimal places), `extended_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `critical_item` (true or false) and `event_date` (YYYY-MM-DD). The tool defines no other outcome.
